description: Adds SendGrid domain authentication CNAMEs, link branding CNAMEs, and a reply subdomain MX so ClickGrow can send and receive email on the business owner's domain.
variableDescription: %mailCnameTarget%: SendGrid mail_cname / return-path CNAME target from createWhitelabelDomain (automatic_security). %dkim1Target% / %dkim2Target%: SendGrid dkim1 / dkim2 CNAME targets (hosts fixed as s1._domainkey / s2._domainkey). %linkDomainTarget%: SendGrid link domain_cname target (host fixed as url). %linkOwnerHost% / %linkOwnerTarget%: SendGrid owner_cname host label + target (owner host is a SendGrid-assigned verification label with no fixed suffix — bare host variable required). Reply MX host is fixed as reply → mx.sendgrid.net priority 10 (never apex MX). All variable values come from stored SendGrid WhitelabelDnsRecord blobs; never invent targets.
